note: Village facts welded into client copy, recorded per file and per rule. This list only ever shrinks. Read scripts/check-village-facts.mjs before editing it, and lower PENDING_CEILING in that file to match the total here.

money.what: a currency amount in display text
money.fix: read the amount and the symbol from the village's own settings. Nobody's prices should travel to a fork.

unit.what: an area or size unit asserted in display text
unit.fix: state the unit from the village's own settings, or state no unit. A hectares village must not read acres.

token-name.what: the recognition token's name as a literal
token-name.fix: read useTokenName() or useTokenNameLower() from client/src/hooks/useTokenNames.ts.

value-token-name.what: the value token's name as a literal

member-name.what: the member noun as a literal
member-name.fix: read project.memberName through the game config. A village calls its people what it likes.

person-name.what: a specific person named in copy shown to users
person-name.fix: name a role or a shared inbox. A first name compiled into the bundle travels to every fork.

client/src/components/SwapCard.tsx::mone.note: A hard dollar prefix in the money formatter. Five more of the same shape are listed under Admin, Contribute, Stay and Wallet.

client/src/pages/Admin.tsx::token-name.note: One of these five is a false positive and graduates by waiver rather than by substitution: the game-variable search hint at Admin.tsx:9198 ("part of a key like 'gratitude'") names the KEY a founder types into the box, so the configured display name would stop it matching any key. Left recorded rather than waived in place because Admin.tsx sits at its check-file-lines baseline and a comment line would fail that ratchet. Whoever burns this entry down: waive that one, read useTokenName() for the other four.

client/src/pages/Admin.tsx::unit.note: Admin-facing help text, both of them. Line 9946 offers the unit options and then states which one a blank field shows, which is the hardcoded default a hectares village inherits. Line 7624 describes the regeneration metrics in one village's unit.

client/src/pages/LoveLetter.tsx::money.note: The dropdown on the page that collects money: four USD bands submitted as data, plus the suggested range above it and the placeholder below.

client/src/pages/MasterPlan.tsx::unit.note: The land tile's label at line 36, which is the fallback when a village states no unit. A hectares village that leaves the note box empty publishes its land in acres.

client/src/pages/Opportunities.tsx::mone.note: Eight USD investment bands with no settings hook at all.
